Overview

Where Europe meets Asia. Walk through the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, explore Topkapi Palace, shop in the Grand Bazaar, cruise the Bosphorus and take a ferry to the car-free Princes' Islands. A rich mix of history, food and culture.

Tour highlights

  • Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia
  • Topkapi Palace and Basilica Cistern
  • Grand Bazaar and Spice Bazaar
  • Bosphorus cruise between Europe and Asia
  • Princes' Islands ferry trip
  • Optional Cappadocia hot-air balloon add-on

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Istanbul

Fly from Mumbai to Istanbul. Transfer to your hotel in Sultanahmet or Taksim. Evening walk on Istiklal Avenue.

Day 2 Old City tour

Guided tour of the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, the Hippodrome and Basilica Cistern. Afternoon at the Grand Bazaar.

  • Breakfast
Day 3 Topkapi Palace & Bosphorus cruise

Visit Topkapi Palace and the Spice Bazaar. Afternoon Bosphorus cruise past palaces and the bridges linking Europe and Asia.

  • Breakfast
Day 4 Princes' Islands

Ferry to Büyükada, the largest of the Princes' Islands. Explore by bicycle or electric cart and enjoy seafood by the water.

  • Breakfast
Day 5 Free day

Day at leisure. Optional: Galata Tower, Eyüp Sultan Mosque, a Turkish bath or a day flight to Cappadocia.

  • Breakfast
Day 6 Depart for Mumbai

Check out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight home.

  • Breakfast

Frequently asked questions

Do Indians get a visa for Turkey easily?

Indian passport holders with a valid US, UK, Schengen or Irish visa can get a Turkey e-visa online. Others need a sticker visa; our visa team handles both.

Can we add Cappadocia?

Yes. A 2-night Cappadocia add-on with a hot-air balloon ride is our most popular extension.
